name: OSS_BALANCE_REGISTER_PERIODS
description: This table is used to capture balance register period object.

columns.name: BALANCE_REGISTER_PERIOD_NUMBER
columns.description: Alternate identifier number of balance register.

columns.name: START_DATE
columns.description: Balance period start date of balance register period.

columns.name: END_DATE
columns.description: Balance period end date of balance register period.

columns.name: CHARGE_PERIOD
columns.description: Field used to capture charge period.

columns.name: CHARGE_PERIOD_BASE_UOM
columns.description: Field used to capture charge period base uom.

columns.name: CHARGE_PERIOD_CONVERSION_RATE
columns.description: Field used to capture charge period conversion rate.

columns.name: TRUEUP_DATE
columns.description: Field used to capture the date on or after true up apply.

columns.name: TRUEUP_FLAG
columns.description: Field used to capture trueup applied or not.

columns.name: BALANCE_PERIOD_SEQUENCE
columns.description: Tracks the balance period sequence for given balance register period.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.
